BiblicalUsage: Parabasis is transgression, the stepping over a stated line. Where no law is, there is no transgression; death reigned from Adam to Moses even over those who had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression; the law was added because of transgressions; and Christ is the mediator of the new testament for the redemption of the transgressions under the first testament.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe transgression is why the law and the cross both exist. The law names the line crossed, and Christ redeems those who crossed it.
